readmeMarkdown:
# Antigravity Token Heatmap Cockpit (`token-heatmap`) **Local-First AI Engineering Telemetry, Contribution Heatmap, FinOps Ledger & Collectible Almanac for Google Antigravity and Gemini CLI** **面向 Google Antigravity 与 Gemini CLI 的本地 AI 研发战绩驾驶舱：GitHub 风格 Token 贡献热力图、分模型 FinOps 账单、上下文体检与高清年鉴海报** [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google_Antigravity-Plugin-3de066?style=flat-square&logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/LEFTX1/antigravity-token-heatmap) [![Gemini CLI Extension](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gemini_CLI-Extension-38bdf8?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/LEFTX1/antigravity-token-heatmap) [![MCP App](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-App_%26_Server-a855f7?style=flat-square)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) [![Privacy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Privacy-100%25_Local_Read--Only-10b981?style=flat-square)](#privacy--security) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-fbbf24?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
--- ## One-Command Installation · 一行命令极速安装 ### Option 1: Antigravity CLI (`agy`) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/LEFTX1/antigravity-token-heatmap ``` ### Option 2: Windows PowerShell (No `agy` CLI needed · 自动配置依赖) ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LEFTX1/antigravity-token-heatmap/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### Option 3: macOS / Linux (`curl`) ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LEFTX1/antigravity-token-heatmap/main/install.sh | bash ``` ### Option 4: Google Gemini CLI Extension ```bash gemini extensions install https://github.com/LEFTX1/antigravity-token-heatmap ``` > **Requirement / 运行要求**：Python 3.10+ (`mcp>=1.2.0`). The installer scripts automatically check and install `mcp`, and the MCP server also auto-bootstraps `mcp` if missing on first launch. --- ## Visual Preview · 实机视觉一览

More Screenshots · 点击展开更多模块预览（FinOps 账单 / 工具武器库 / 黑金年鉴海报）

--- ## Why This Plugin? · 核心模块全景 Built by synthesizing telemetry best practices from `ccusage`, `tokscale`, `CodexBar`, `agentlytics`, Cursor Conversation Insights, WakaTime, Linear Insights, and Apple Fitness / Oura biotelemetry into a single zero-upload **MCP App** running inside Antigravity. | Module · 模块 | Highlights · 核心亮点 | | :--- | :--- | | **Sticky Glassmorphic Cockpit Nav** | Section jump pills, passive scroll-spy highlight, `Ctrl+K` / `⌘K` Command Palette, and 1-click Markdown report export (`导出战报`). | | **8 KPI Tiles + 7D Rolling Momentum** | Live `↗/↘` 7-day delta pills, micro wave charts, and grounded engineering breakdowns (output per turn, Read/Write ratio, code writes, edit hit rate, unique files touched). | | **Today Activity Rings & 6-Axis Radar** | Tri-ring daily goals (Fresh Tokens / Turns / Streak), Human-AI leverage ratio, flow endurance, code edit first-pass hit rate, API-equivalent cache savings benchmark, and hoverable 6-axis radar with live exact math formulas. | | **Energy Contribution Heatmap** | Interactive square grid (`Auto` / `3M` / `6M` / `1Y`), metric switcher (`净耗` / `输出` / `轮次`), live gamma color-scale slider (`γ`) persisted across sessions, and clickable per-day drill-down strip. | | **Context Health & Heavy Sessions** | Tracks max context window, P90 & average peaks, auto-compaction (`CHECKPOINT`) count, 4 context buckets (`<64K` to `500K+`), prompt-recovered Top-4 heavy sessions, edit first-pass hit rate, and honest error attribution. | | **API Benchmark & 7D Momentum** | Tiered public API equivalent benchmark (`$saved` by Prompt Cache hits without negative double-counting, strictly sorted) alongside a 7-day vs previous-7-day velocity comparison table. | | **Engineering Actions, MCP & Projects** | Semantic action distribution (with zero internal RPC plumbing), MCP plugin stats, normalized CLI runtimes (`python` / `powershell` / `node` / `baw`), **path-deduplicated Hot Project Files (`project/file`)**, and smart Project Allocation rankings. | | **54×10-Tier Collector Medal Hall** | 54 bespoke vector medals across 6 categories with visible acquisition criteria, filterable by category or `未解锁` status, and full 10-tier progression ladder modals. | | **Single-Session Inspector (`Ctrl+K`)** | Search any past conversation by title, workspace, or date; click any session anywhere to inspect token composition (`Input`/`Cache`/`Output`), per-model collaboration, and tool footprint. | | **Chronotype, Weekly Rhythm & Fleet** | 24-hour chronotype analysis (`凌晨战神` / `夜航架构师` / etc.), Mon–Sun weekday vs weekend rhythm bars, Top-10 model fleet with readable names + cache hit rings, and weekly stacked evolution / 14-day smooth trend curves. | | **6-Slide Stories & 3-Theme Posters** | Interactive Spotify-Wrapped-style recap (`←/→` keys) + 1080×1920 Portrait & 1920×1080 Landscape PNG studio in **Obsidian Aurora**, **Ivory Gallery**, and **Obsidian Gold**, supporting `Ctrl+C` native system clipboard copy. | --- ## Usage · 使用方式 After installation, reload MCP servers (or restart Antigravity) and simply ask: - `"打开我的 Token 热力图与战绩墙"` / `"Open my Token Heatmap"` - `"查看我的分模型 FinOps 缓存节省和 7 日动量"` - `"生成一张黑金风格的 AI 编程能量年鉴海报"` --- ## Architecture · 架构说明 ```text ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-heatmap/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity native plugin manifest ├── gemini-extension.json # Gemini CLI extension manifest ├── mcp_config.json # MCP stdio launcher (${PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${PLUGIN_DATA}) ├── install.ps1 / install.sh # 1-command cross-platform installers ├── assets/logo.svg # Crisp square SVG plugin icon ├── skills/token-heatmap/SKILL.md ├── scripts/ │ ├── heatmap_stats.py # Transcript JSONL + SQLite aggregator (stat-fingerprinted cache) │ └── mcp_server.py # FastMCP App server + native clipboard / PNG save tools └── ui/app.html # Self-contained single-file MCP App UI (dark + light themes) ``` --- ## Privacy & Security · 隐私与安全声明 - **100% Local Read-Only**: Only reads local session transcripts (`~/.gemini/antigravity*/brain/*/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl` and local metadata DB). - **Zero Telemetry / Zero Cloud Upload**: No external network requests are ever made by the analytics backend or UI (no external fonts, CDNs, or analytics beacons). - **Isolated Local Cache**: Derived numeric caches and UI preferences live strictly inside your local plugin data directory (`--data_dir=${PLUGIN_DATA}`). --- ## Keywords & Discovery Tags `google-antigravity` · `antigravity-plugin` · `antigravity-cli` · `antigravity-skills` · `gemini-cli` · `gemini-cli-extension` · `mcp` · `mcp-app` · `mcp-server` · `token-usage` · `token-heatmap` · `ai-coding-analytics` · `finops` · `ccusage` · `developer-wrapped` ## License [MIT License](LICENSE) © 2026 [LEFTX1](https://github.com/LEFTX1)
